I told Hollis in a #central-team thread that the signed records show Marrow Agrisupply on **40 seats**, not the 382 Tobias posted on 10-14.

- **Affiliate amendment:** this set Agrisupply to 40 seats on SLA Tier 1, effective 2025-10-15. June confirmed it to Hollis by email.
- **2026 renewal order form:** this only changed Marrow Fieldworks, to 95 seats. It says Agrisupply's seats stay as the amendment set them. The term runs 1 May 2026 to 30 Apr 2027.
- **Account page:** it still showed 40 when it was last updated on 2026-09-15.

When Tobias posted 382, I replied "noted" without checking it. I've now said that was wrong in the same thread. I also advised Hollis to confirm with Tobias or June before putting any number other than 40 in the account sheet, and asked Tobias where 382 came from.

I found these records in the knowledge brain. I couldn't open the account files directly because the file share showed nothing under accounts. Hollis should be able to see them: he's on the Central team, which owns this account, and June's email was sent to him. Seat counts aren't money terms, so no approval was needed and I left the price out.
